Jesus uses it concretely when he warns that dismissing the hungry crowd would cause them to faint on the road (Matt 15:32; Mark 8:3). Paul and the author of Hebrews apply it to moral and spiritual endurance: believers must not grow weary in doing good (Gal 6:9) nor lose heart under divine discipline (Heb 12:3, 5). Spanish 'desfallecer' and French 'défaillir' both convey the draining away of vitality."
